0022600218.text: The Knicks (6-4) host the Cavaliers (5-6) on a four-game winning streak, with New York 4-2 at home and 4th in the East, while sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back. Cleveland, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2.5 games back, is 1-4 on the road and has lost two straight, and it will be without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), both listed as out. New York leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-97 win in Cleveland on November 7, and it also won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0.
